queries:
SELECT AVG(event_avg) AS mean_above_average
FROM (
    SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS event_avg
    FROM budget
    GROUP BY link_to_event
)
WHERE event_avg > (SELECT AVG(amount) FROM budget);
SELECT AVG(amount) AS mean_among_above_average_events
FROM budget
WHERE link_to_event IN (
    SELECT link_to_event
    FROM budget
    GROUP BY link_to_event
    HAVING AVG(amount) > (SELECT AVG(amount) FROM budget)
);
WITH event_avg AS (
    SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount
    FROM budget
    GROUP BY link_to_event
)
SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS mean_above_average_events
FROM event_avg
WHERE avg_amount > (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) FROM event_avg);
WITH ev AS (
    SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount
    FROM budget
    GROUP BY link_to_event
)
SELECT AVG(amount)
FROM budget
WHERE link_to_event IN (
    SELECT link_to_event
    FROM ev
    WHERE avg_amount > (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) FROM ev)
);
SELECT link_to_event, AVG(spent) AS avg_spent
FROM budget
WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY link_to_event
UNION ALL
SELECT NULL AS link_to_event, AVG(spent) AS avg_spent
FROM budget
SELECT AVG(amount) FROM budget WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL
